review.reason: The answer’s main capability list is largely backed by the passages: CMX500 cellular/WLAN signaling, Wi‑Fi 7/8 features, dRU/UEQM, AP/STA options, OTA integrations, NTN/DTC, application/IP/audio testing, automation, and CMP180 production RF testing are all evidenced.
